scope: Installed source controller and camera invariants; not actual DOM or WebGL verification

checks.name: Original-equivalent custom look stays explicitly selected and can be deleted
Two identical custom looks remain independently selectable and deletable
Consecutive failed setting changes remain live and recover alongside latest other-tab fields
Failed custom save creates no ghost saved look and leaves live temporary settings intact
Compare is temporary and reset selects exact Original without deleting custom looks
Prism framing covers both endpoints while retaining its safe camera position and exact default
Reflection strength multiplies radiance and defaults to1 instead of recoloring the reflector
Transient impact is explicitly unavailable for Record and orbit speed for composed views
Actual Studio edits notify manual bypass and close temporary Compare before changing saved settings
